summary_en: The study tests Epidiferphane given together with taxane chemotherapy (paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel, or docetaxel) in people with breast cancer. Epidiferphane is taken as tablets by mouth three times daily, for a maximum of three months. The record does not list a primary outcome measure; it says the study will look at side effects and tumor response rate, and it is a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa Epidiferphane administrado junto con quimioterapia con taxanos (paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel o docetaxel) en personas con cáncer de mama. Epidiferphane se toma en tabletas por vía oral tres veces al día, durante un máximo de tres meses. El registro no enumera una medida de resultado principal; indica que el estudio observará los efectos secundarios y la tasa de respuesta tumoral, y es un estudio de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Breast cancer. Phase I: starting neoadjuvant chemotherapy or metastatic breast cancer. Phase II: breast cancer of any stage.
About to start paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel, or docetaxel at UF Health at the listed doses.
ECOG performance status 3 or less, per treating physician.
Will continue cancer therapy at UF Health for at least the next three months.
not_for: Grade 2 or higher peripheral sensory or motor neuropathy, or grade 1 or higher paresthesia.
ALT or AST above 2.5 times the upper limit of normal, bilirubin above set limits, or GFR under 50 mL/min.
Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors such as tacrolimus or verapamil, or known allergy to turmeric, broccoli, or green tea.
